mapper.select:
/* selectOperRptList - Lee SangHoon */
C.BIZ_YR AS BIZ_YR, /* 사업연도 */ B.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NM AS SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NM, /* 서비스실행사업명 */ G.PVSN_RESRCE_NM AS PVSN_RESRCE_NM, /* 자원명 */ D.INST_NM AS OPER_INST_NM, /* 운영기관 */ A.TTL_NM AS TTL_NM, /* 제목명 */ H.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS RPT_SE_NM, /* 보고구분 */ A.PRD_BGNG_YMD AS PRD_BGNG_YMD, /* 기간시작일자 */ A.PRD_END_YMD AS PRD_END_YMD, /* 기간종료일자 */ A.APLY_PIC_NO AS APLY_PIC_NO /* 신청담당자번호 */ ,A.APLY_YMD AS APLY_YMD, /* 신청일자 */ (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 /* 공통코드(승인상태구분코드) */ WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID LIKE 'APRV_STTS_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = A.APRV_STTS_SE_CD ) AS DOC_STTS_NM, /* 문서상태 */ DEC_B64(NVL(F.FLNM_ENCPT,E.FLNM_ENCPT)) AS PRCR_NM, /* 승인자 */ A.PRCS_YMD AS PRCS_YMD, /* 승인일자 */
A.RESRCE_NO AS RESRCE_NO, /* 자원번호 */ A.RPT_SE_CD AS RPT_SE_CD, /* 보고구분코드 */ A.TASKWK_RPT_SN AS TASKWK_RPT_SN /* 업무보고일련번호 */
FROM AFA210 A /* 업무보고 */ JOIN SDA100 G /* 자원기본 */ ON G.RESRCE_NO = A.RESRCE_NO LEFT JOIN SDA420 B /* 서비스실행사업 */ ON B.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO = G.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO LEFT JOIN SDA400 C /* 서비스사업 */ ON B.SRVC_BIZ_NO = C.SRVC_BIZ_NO LEFT JOIN SAA000 D /* 통합기관 */ ON D.INST_NO = G.RSFR_INST_NO LEFT JOIN SCA100 E /* 종사자 */ ON E.ENFSN_NO = A.APRV_PIC_NO LEFT JOIN SCA300 F /* 개인정보 */ ON F.INDV_IDNTFC_NO = E.INDV_IDNTFC_NO LEFT JOIN SAC100 H /* 공통코드[보고구분코드] */ ON H.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'RPT_SE_CD' AND H.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = A.RPT_SE_CD
WHERE 1=1 AND C.BIZ_YR LIKE #{BIZ_YR} || '%' AND B.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO LIKE #{SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO} || '%' AND D.INST_NO LIKE #{INST_NO} || '%' AND A.RESRCE_NO LIKE #{RESRCE_NO} || '%' AND A.RPT_SE_CD LIKE #{RPT_SE_CD} || '%' AND A.APRV_STTS_SE_CD LIKE #{APRV_STTS_SE_CD} || '%' AND A.APLY_YMD BETWEEN #{BGNG_YMD} AND #{END_YMD} AND H.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE1 = #{RPT_SE_ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE1} AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND A.RPT_SE_CD != '01'
ORDER BY A.TASKWK_RPT_SN DESC

/* selectOperRpt - Lee SangHoon */
SELECT
(SELECT BIZ_YR FROM SDA400 /* 서비스사업 */ WHERE SRVC_BIZ_NO = (SELECT SRVC_BIZ_NO FROM SDA420 /* 서비스실행사업 */ WHERE SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO = (SELECT SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO FROM SDA100 /* 자원기본 */ WHERE RESRCE_NO = A.RESRCE_NO)) ) AS BIZ_YR, /* 사업연도 */ A.RESRCE_NO AS RESRCE_NO, /* 자원번호 */ A.RPT_SE_CD AS RPT_SE_CD, /* 보고구분코드 */ A.PRD_BGNG_YMD AS PRD_BGNG_YMD, /* 기간시작일자 */ A.PRD_END_YMD AS PRD_END_YMD, /* 기간종료일자 */ A.APLY_YMD AS APLY_YMD, /* 신청일자 */ DEC_B64(NVL(C.FLNM_ENCPT,B.FLNM_ENCPT)) AS APLCNT_NM, /* 신청자 */ A.TTL_NM AS TTL_NM, /* 제목명 */ A.RPT_CN AS RPT_CN, /* 보고내용 */
A.APRV_STTS_SE_CD as APRV_STTS_SE_CD, /* 승인상태구분코드 */ DEC_B64(NVL(E.FLNM_ENCPT,D.FLNM_ENCPT)) AS PRCR_NM, /* 승인자 */ A.RJCT_CS_CN AS RJCT_CS_CN, /* 반려사유내용 */ A.ATFINO AS ATFINO, /* 첨부파일번호 */
A.TASKWK_RPT_SN AS TASKWK_RPT_SN /* 업무보고일련번호 */
FROM AFA210 A /* 업무보고 */ LEFT JOIN SCA100 B /* 종사자 - 신청자 */ ON B.ENFSN_NO = A.APLY_PIC_NO LEFT JOIN SCA300 C /* 개인정보 - 신청자 */ ON C.INDV_IDNTFC_NO = B.INDV_IDNTFC_NO LEFT JOIN SCA100 D /* 종사자 - 승인자 */ ON D.ENFSN_NO = A.APRV_PIC_NO LEFT JOIN SCA300 E /* 개인정보 - 승인자 */ ON E.INDV_IDNTFC_NO = D.INDV_IDNTFC_NO
WHERE 1=1 AND A.RESRCE_NO LIKE #{RESRCE_NO} AND A.RPT_SE_CD LIKE #{RPT_SE_CD} AND A.TASKWK_RPT_SN LIKE #{TASKWK_RPT_SN}
